row.evidence: Filevine's help centre says SAML 'serves as a method of authentication only' and new SAML users get an account on first sign-in; no SCIM endpoint appears in the pricing page, help centre or API reference.
row.notes: Quote-only pricing ('All packages are custom built'). No SCIM documented: help-centre search for 'scim' returns 0 articles and the Stoplight API reference has no SCIM section. SSO via SAML (set up by Filevine support, JIT account creation) or self-serve OIDC (guides reference Okta, Ping, Microsoft Entra, JumpCloud). Admins disable users in the Account Manager (session ends within an hour). The v2 REST API (API gateway, PAT + client ID/secret) lists, invites (Filevine Identity POST /identity/user) and removes users from an Org and manages teams and project roles; the old Create User endpoint was removed. No IdP catalogue apps found (Okta OIN, Entra Learn, JumpCloud pages 404).

plans.name: Custom package
plans.price_text: Contact our sales team for a custom quote
plans.notes: No public tiers; SSO supported per security FAQ; SCIM not documented anywhere (scim false by absence).

scim.notes: Not documented: help-centre search 'scim' returns 0 results; API reference table of contents has no SCIM section.

methods: Personal Access Token exchanged for bearer token
auth.notes: Requests run as a service account user whose Filevine permissions apply.

capabilities.notes: Create User endpoint removed; users are invited via Filevine Identity POST /identity/user. DELETE /users/{userId} removes the user from the Org and projects but does not delete them. Teams act as groups.

endpoints.purpose: Remove user from the Org and all projects
Assign roles to a project team member

webhooks_user_events.notes: Event types are returned by GET /fv-app/v2/webhooks/Events (c24); user events not confirmed.

rate_limits.text: Token-bucket limits per API tier (by client application ID for partners, tenant ID for customers); 429 when exhausted. Default credentials have restricted limits; higher access by request.

limitations.text: Create User endpoint has been removed; invite via Filevine Identity instead.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/filevine/ returns 404; Filevine's OIDC guide links Okta OIDC setup instructions (custom app).
